notes.title: Mythic items!
notes.content:
Features:
- New rarity: Mythic
- Mythic items can drop on difficulty multiplier 20 and above
- Mythic items can have the same special powers as legendary items, and some new powers as well
- Autosell for legendary items added
- Weapons now have thorns, too
- New items now have an icon to indicate if they are indeed new
- Gained money from autosell is now shown similarly as a gained stat upgrade

Adjustments:
- Shop upgrade max price increased
- Support for localization
- HP item now grants more HP but appears less often
- Changes to luck
- Get some, give some damage increases thorns damage too

Bug fixes:
- Doghouse now shows up in unlocks list
- Item prices were lower than intended after loading the game
- Disabling item rolling will now also clear the roll queue (does not affect the gained loot - just a UI thing)
- Fixed one prefix not appearing at all
